solves.reasoning: 원문: regulate(조절) / express(표현) / unified(통합). 모두 원문 그대로인 조합은 ①.
internalize their cultures / origins of human history / facilitate contacts 원문 그대로 = ④.
language is the vehicle / multilingual people / globally interconnected world 원문 = ④.
②abandon은 원문 internalize(내면화)의 반대. 나머지 inherently/vehicle/exchange는 적절.
④sluggish(느린)는 원문 rapid means of travel의 반대. connect/common/ably는 적절.
③rivalry(경쟁)는 원문 exchange and of caring의 caring과 모순. social/regulate/globally는 적절.
language is the ___ through which we learn → vehicle(매개체). barrier/obstacle/replacement는 문맥 반대.
We can ___ with people through the internet → transact(거래하다). 원문 transact.
they must ___ their cultures, 뒤 문장 cannot be internalized → internalize(내면화).
regulate(조절하다) 동의어 = control. eliminate/abandon/celebrate 무관.
facilitate(촉진하다) 동의어 = promote. hinder/prevent/restrict는 반대.
origins(기원) 동의어 = beginnings. conclusions/outcomes/boundaries 무관.
express(표현하다) 반의어 = suppress(억누르다). convey/reveal/demonstrate는 동의어.
facilitate(촉진하다) 반의어 = impede(방해하다). encourage/support/assist는 동의어.
(A) rapid means of travel = 수단, (B) Respect means that~ = 의미하다 → 수단-의미하다.
'make a process easier' 정의 = facilitate. complicate은 반대, regulate/internalize 무관.
social ___ (interact), their social interactions가 원문 → 명사 interactions.
globally ___ (interconnect) world → 과거분사 형용사 interconnected (globally interconnected world).
connect with others, both in ___ → relationships of exchange and of caring 원문. 나머지는 부정적/무관.
Today we humans exist in ___ → a globally interconnected world 원문. divided/homogeneous/isolated는 반대.
